param.name: Text
param.value: 'defaults loaded on game load, %1 settings, %2 overridden'.[$Defaults.keys.count, $Overrides.keys.count]

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$DebugLog'}
set_value.comment: 1 = write FDN debug lines to the game log

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$LogLevel'}
set_value.comment: 1 = errors, 2 = +warnings, 3 = +info, 4 = +debug detail

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$PollInterval'}
set_value.comment: seconds between supply passes

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$PollStationsPerPass'}
set_value.comment: how many stations each supply pass looks at

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$TransferFeePercent'}
set_value.comment: fee as percent of transfer value (Matt: 2 is OK as a placeholder)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$TransferDelay'}
set_value.comment: 1 = delay transfers by gate distance. Instant when 0

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$TransferDelayMult'}
set_value.comment: seconds of delay per gate jump (Matt: start at 8)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$RangeLimit'}
set_value.comment: 1 = only use stations within RangeMaxJumps gate jumps. 0 = no distance limit

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$RangeMaxJumps'}
set_value.comment: max gate jumps when RangeLimit is on. Minimum 1, no upper maximum

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$NpcFallback'}
set_value.comment: 1 = buy shortfalls from NPC offers when no own station can cover (card 09r: on by default, proven in game; 0 turns it off). NPCs only qualify when the station buy price is raised above the ware minimum

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$DCNetworkRange'}
set_value.comment: max gate jumps between two DCs for them to join one network

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$DCKeepPercent'}
set_value.comment: percent of each ware a DC always keeps (used from card 9b)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$DCKeepWare'}
set_value.comment: per-ware keep percent override, ware -> percent (used from card 9b)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$LedgerMax'}
set_value.comment: max ledger entries kept per DC (used from card 9b)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$FeeRangeMult'}
set_value.comment: fee range factor: fee x (1 + jumps x this). Default 0.2 (3 jumps = 1.6x base). Decimals allowed

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$FeeVolumeMult'}
set_value.comment: fee volume factor, flat for now. Decimals allowed

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$FeeTypeMult'}
set_value.comment: fee ware-type factor, flat for now. Decimals allowed

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ReturnFeeMult'}
set_value.comment: card 9c-fee: station-to-DC return fee = supply fee x this (Matt: half). The DC pays. Decimals allowed

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$DCToDCFeeMult'}
set_value.comment: card 9c-fee / 9f: DC to DC pull fee = supply fee x this, paid by the home DC (Supply_Station). 0 = pulls are free. Decimals allowed

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$TriggerMinGap'}
set_value.comment: card 9e: min seconds between two production-finished checks of the same station. Later checks wait, they are not dropped

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$LogbookSkipInterval'}
set_value.comment: seconds before the same skipped station and ware is written to the logbook again

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$LogbookLevel'}
set_value.comment: card 09o: game logbook detail. 0 = off, 1 = problems only, 2 = problems + one summary per supply run and DC network changes, 3 = problems + every transfer (throttled per station and ware) and DC network changes

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$NotifyMoneySkip'}
set_value.comment: card 09o: 1 = on-screen ticker message when a transfer is skipped because a DC cannot pay. Only when LogbookLevel is 1 or more

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CyclesToCover'}
set_value.comment: production cycles of resources FDN supplies ahead. Card 9e: default 2 (was 1); set back to 1 here to revert

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ResourcesFdnManaged'}
set_value.comment: 1 = FDN supplies this station's resources

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ProductsFdnManaged'}
set_value.comment: 1 = this station's products go to its nearest DC (card 9c)

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ProductMinBatch'}
set_value.comment: card 9c: smallest amount of a product sent to the DC in one go

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ProductCyclesToKeep'}
set_value.comment: card X4-18i: cycles of each product a station keeps before returning the rest. 0 = return all above ProductMinBatch. ProductKeepWare overrides per ware when set

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$OverstockTriggerPct'}
set_value.comment: card X4-17a/18i: only collect when stock is this percent above keep (0 = any surplus). Dual-use keep = CyclesToCover required; other resources = cargo.target. 0 to 100

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$ProductKeepWare'}
set_value.comment: card 9c/18i: per-ware keep amount override for returns, ware -> amount. When set for a ware it overrides ProductCyclesToKeep for that ware

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterFeePercent'}
set_value.comment: charter fee = this percent of the average price of the most expensive qualifying dock on the station

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterFeeFloor'}
set_value.comment: lowest charter fee in whole Cr, before reputation discount

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterFeeCap'}
set_value.comment: highest charter fee in whole Cr, before reputation discount

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterMinStanding'}
set_value.comment: minimum standing (-30 to +30) with the sector owner (else best main faction). -30 switches the gate off

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDiscStep1'}
set_value.comment: standing for discount 1

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDisc1'}
set_value.comment: discount 1, percent off the fee

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDiscStep2'}
set_value.comment: standing for discount 2

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDisc2'}
set_value.comment: discount 2, percent off the fee

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDiscStep3'}
set_value.comment: standing for discount 3

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterDisc3'}
set_value.comment: discount 3, percent off the fee

set_value.name: $Defaults.{'$CharterMacros'}
set_value.comment: card X4-14a: dock areas and piers that qualify for a charter (base, Split, Boron, Terran). Not ship-build bays, equipment docks, showroom, venturer, Xenon or Teladi landmark parts. Card X4-14c: a chartered station is a DC only while it has one of these, operational
